Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Pre-Bid Meeting Information A pre-bid meeting shall be held to clarify the bid terms, scope, eligibility and specifications .Attendance is manda tory and is a condition of eligibility. Particulars Details Organizer Principal, Livelihood College, Korba (C.G.) – 495677 Date and time 13/11/2026] at 13:00 hrs (also published on GeM) Venue / mode Livelihood College, Korba Last date for queries 12/11/2026], before the meeting Query submission In writing, clause-wise, by e-mail to livelihood.korba@gmail.com Clauses on Pre-Bid Meeting 1. A pre-bid meeting will be held on the date, time and venue mentioned above to clarify the bid terms, scope of work, eligib ility criteria and technical specifications to prospective bidders. A working demonstration of the offered product shall be conducted during the meeting as per the clauses below. 2. Attendance of an authorized representative of the bidder at the pre-bid meeting and a live working demonst ration of the offered agriculture drone are MANDATORY for all participating bidders. A bidder who does not attend, or does not complete the demonstration, shall not be eligible to participate and its bid shall be reje cted. 3. Bidders must send the name and mobile number of their representative in advance. The representative must carry an authority letter on the firm's letterhead and a copy of the DGCA Type Certificate of the drone model offered. 4. The drone demonstrated must be of the same make and model, with the same specifications, as offered in the bid, and m ust be brought with the complete kit (flight batteries, charger, controller with mobile app, spray system and accessories). Transport, batteries, water and all other consumables shall be arranged by the bidder at its own cost. 5. The working demonstration shall include, at a minimum: unfolding and set-up of the drone; pre-flight checks; take-off, hov er and landing; spraying operation with water payload; Auto / AB Point and map-based navigation; geofencing; Return-to -Home and other safety features; display of the mobile app in Hindi/English; and any other test asked by the committee to verify compliance with the technical specifications.

6. The demonstration shall be held in the presence of the committee in a designated open area, in time slots allotted to each bidder. The committee shall record the compliance of the demonstrated drone against the technical specifications. 7. The flight shall be operated by a person qualified as per DGCA rules. The bidder shall be solely responsible for flight safety , permissions, insurance, and any damage or injury during the demonstration; the department shall not be liable. 8. After successful demonstration, the department shall issue a signed and stamped demonstration certificate to the bidder. This certificate shall be uploaded as a mandatory attachment with the online bid, and shall be treated as the certificatio n required under the sample demonstration clause of this bid . Failure to upload it shall lead to rejection of the bid. 9. Attendance by other persons is at the bidder's own cost; the department shall not reimburse any expenses. 10. Queries must be sent in writing, clause-wise, on or before the last date for submission of queries. Queries received after t his date, or raised only orally, may not be considered. 11. The department's replies given at the meeting are for clarification only and are not binding unless incorporated in the min utes and issued as a corrigendum / amendment on the GeM portal. 12. Any amendment to the bid conditions, specifications or bid end date arising from the pre-bid meeting shall be published o n the GeM portal only. Bidders must check GeM regularly and submit their bids in accordance with the corrigendum. 13. The minutes of the pre-bid meeting and the list of bidders who completed the demonstration shall be uploaded on the Ge M portal and shall form part of the bid document. 14. The department reserves the right to modify, add or delete any condition of the bid, to reschedule the demonstration or e xtend the bid end date, without assigning any reason. .
